scope: Design a static glucose-responsive or constant-release formulation for a known cohort. Public white-box physiology; new meal scenarios. No unseen-patient or clinical efficacy claim.

simulator.verifier_integrator: native T1DSimEnv dopri5, compiled equivalent RHS, minute-level audit
simulator.glucose_signal: interstitial glucose; no CGM noise in passive release

design.shared_parameters: One static parameter vector per instance, amplitude and reservoir scaled by each known native TDI. No patient-specific fitting, live controller, meal bolus, or physiology edits.
design.constant: rate = theta_c*TDI U/min, with the same finite theta_L*TDI reservoir; theta_c in [0,0.007].

scenarios.meal_scaling: Native RandomScenario grams multiplied by BW/86.0704. Day-2 missed lunch 10:00-14:00; day-2 dinner 16:00-20:01 multiplied by 1.5.
scenarios.sealing: Sealed instance inputs and evaluation seeds excluded from agent image, public git, and public transcripts; supplied per trial only after runner and algorithms are frozen. SHA256 commitments include random salts.

score.primary: feasibility_rate across instances; tie-break mean safe_tir
score.safe_tir: Equal patient/scenario mean TIR [70,180] if every safety constraint and output contract passes; otherwise 0. No post-hoc threshold changes.
score.failure_policy: Malformed/out-of-bounds/missing design, incomplete/nonfinite simulation, or failed safety: score 0 with reason. API/host infrastructure errors remain recorded and are not silently dropped.

budget.query_counts: diagnostic only; full public simulator permits custom optimizers
budget.timing: Container CPU usage measured by cgroup; paused during API requests. Dependency/JIT warmup excluded for everyone. Baselines and agents use the same image and CPU cap.

submission.grading: Verifier parses design.json only; never imports or executes submitted search.py. Search code and rationale are retained as audit evidence, not LLM-graded.

baselines.reference: No global optimality or statistical ranking claim from this pilot.

agent_pilot.selection: Two explicit Magpie routes that pass a non-benchmark tool-call connectivity check, frozen before score trials. Report requested and returned model identities.
agent_pilot.interpretation: 24 agent trials are an engineering pilot; six sealed cases are too few to claim a stable model ranking.

public: sanitized per-trial model results and development transcripts
private: sealed task inputs and evaluation seeds
